result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the bottom navigation has a prominent visual overlap that makes some navigation controls appear broken or obscured.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar runs across the bottom navigation, overlapping the search and center navigation icons and making the navigation area look corrupted.
issues.suggestion: Remove the unintended bar or correct its positioning so it does not overlap the navigation icons; verify the active-tab indicator is rendered as a properly sized element.
